bannerText: Muse X Poster: bài đã điền sẵn (đã bỏ tag Binance). Bấm Post trên X để đăng, rồi báo Muse là xong.
note: Muse X Poster v1.5: fill the post with a SYNTHETIC PASTE EVENT (DataTransfer with text/plain dispatched on the editor) instead of insertText. Lexical has a dedicated paste handler that splits multi-line pasted text into blocks correctly; both the single multi-line insertText (v1.3) and the line-by-line insert (v1.4) garbled the post because the caret jumps when Lexical re-renders. Line-by-line is kept only as a fallback when the paste produces nothing at all. A fill mismatch now also logs to the console ("fill mismatch: filled X chars, expected Y chars"). v1.3's focused-editor selection, replace-instead-of-append, and fail-on-mismatch checks are unchanged.
